Fixed the cycle diagnostic in `src/packaging/dependency_groups.py`.

`_validate()` now passes the normalized `include_group` to `CyclicDependencyGroup` instead of the raw `item.include_group`. This makes the `include_group == group` branch in the exception work for differently-spelled self-includes (e.g. `"A"` for `"a"`, `"A_B"` for `"a.b"`), so it reports `"<group> includes itself"` rather than a bogus two-node cycle.

Public tests: `45 passed`.

card.problem: fix(dependency-groups): report self-inclusion for unnormalized spellings (#1519)
card.expected:
_validate() normalizes the include name before testing it against the
include stack, but passed the raw item.include_group to
CyclicDependencyGroup. The exception branches on include_group == group
where group is already normalized, so a self-include spelled differently
(e.g. "A" for group "a", or "A_B" for "a.b") fell into the two-node
template and reported a cycle between two names that are one group.

Pass the normalized name so the diagnostic matches the cycle actually
detected.
